data.desc: Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: RIME) is a diversified holding company focused on identifying, acquiring, and scaling innovative businesses in high-growth markets. The Company's two primary operating businesses are Azure Energy and SemiCab Holdings. Azure Energy provides strategic and technical advisory services for renewable biomass power generation infrastructure. Since launching in 2025, Azure has secured equity interests in multiple U.S. power projects currently under development, with an estimated aggregate net present value exceeding $220 million, while establishing multi-year consulting contracts that provide recurring fee revenue. For additional information about Azure Energy, please visit www.azure-energy.co. Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. also owns and operates SemiCab, an AI-enabled logistics software provider. Since 2020, SemiCab has enabled major retailers, brands and transportation providers to address common supply-chain problems globally.
